name: taiwan-student-benefits
tagline_zh: 台湾大学生常错过免费订阅？这个技能自动追踪 50+ 学生福利，GitHub、JetBrains、Notion 等。
tagline_en: Never miss a freebie again—track 50+ Taiwan student perks, from GitHub to Notion, with expiry alerts.
desc_en: Taiwan .edu.tw student benefits tracker and reminder system. Discovers, tracks, and reminds students of 50+ free subscriptions and credits available to Taiwan university students (GitHub Student Pack, JetBrains, Azure, Figma, Notion, etc.). Use this skill whenever the user mentions: student benefits, edu.tw perks, free student subscriptions, GitHub Student Pack, student developer tools, academic d
why_zh: 同类工具只列清单，它主动盯到期日并提醒，把「知道有福利」变成「真领到手」。
why_en: Others list perks; this one tracks expiry dates and nudges you, turning 'knowing' into 'actually claiming'.
